verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents registrable webhooks that POST when a payment or other event occurs, and an API for charging customers, which lets an agent watch payment outcomes and re-attempt charges. Subscriptions are supported via payment plans. However, nothing in the evidence describes failed-payment-specific events, automatic retry logic, or dunning outreach, so the agent would have to build retries and outreach itself. missing for 10: explicit failed-payment/charge-failure webhook events, built-in retry/smart-retry scheduling, dunning email/outreach capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: Receive a POST request from Flutterwave when a payment, payout, or other event happens on your account.
Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox
Collect card, bank, and other payment details with your own UI, then charge the customer through the API.
Payment plans let you set up subscriptions for your customers on Flutterwave.
